topic: Cove Sensory MCP: Giving Text-Only LLMs Eyes and Ears Locally

key_points: Local stdio MCP server giving text-only LLMs eyes/ears via configured multimodal providers.
58 stars, 14 forks, Apache 2.0, created 2026-08-08; Python/PowerShell/Shell; single contributor moonlin1213.
Sensory layer only — no chat, memory, personality, playback, monitoring, or call policy.
Setup: git clone + uv sync --locked + doctor + print-config for renderer (generic/codex/claude-desktop/claude-code).
FFmpeg optional for image but required for video/audio prep; configure credential store not chat (env:VAR or OS store).
Native local multimodal workflow tool adding image/video/audio/music sensing to text agents.
Path whitelists + credential storage + HTTPS restrictions for security; aligns with GDPR/CCPA.
FFmpeg dependency management needed for audio/video; cross-provider fallback improves stability.
Works with Codex and Claude Code to call multimodal tools.
Listed MCP server; install via Glama hosted flow and invoke with @cove-sensory-mcp.
Media only sent to selected authorized Provider; cross-provider fallback never inferred.
Abs path must be within configured roots; URLs must be direct HTTPS, blocked: redirects, credentials, private networks, localhost, metadata endpoints.
Explains MCP as universal connector standard for AI/tool integration context.

stats.fact: Cove Sensory MCP hit 58 GitHub stars and 14 forks within a month of its 2026-08-08 creation.
Repository is Apache License 2.0 with a single top contributor (moonlin1213, 71 contributions) and 0 open issues.
Exposes four sensing tools: sense_image, sense_video, sense_audio, sense_music, plus sensory_setup_guide, sensory_status, and sensory_self_test helpers.
Anthropic's Model Context Protocol announcement story reached 872 points on Hacker News, showing strong MCP community momentum.

angles: Privacy-safe local multimodal: keep media on-device, only selected provider sees files — GDPR/CCPA angle.
Sensory layer philosophy: deliberately NOT a full assistant — a composable building block for agents.
Provider picker: Gemini as eye+ear, MiniMax-M3 as image/video-only eye, OpenAI-compatible audio_url_data_uri (e.g. Qwen3-Omni via SiliconFlow) as ear.
Security posture: path whitelists, OS credential store, HTTPS-only URLs, blocked private/localhost/redirects.
Practical setup walkthrough with uv, doctor, print-config per renderer (Codex, Claude Code, Claude Desktop).
